_comment: Manual-input overrides merged into src/data/fund-data.json by scripts/fund-data-query.mjs (applyFundOverrides). The query script regenerates fund-data.json wholesale, so manual data must live here. Keys under firms must match firmRaw exactly. capitalType: fund | evergreen | balance-sheet (default fund). announcedFunds: web-verified final-close sizes ONLY — every entry needs a sourceUrl; never add unverified sizes.

Wren House Infrastructure Management.capitalNote: Kuwait Investment Authority's infrastructure arm — sovereign single-LP evergreen capital; never appears in Form D or US pension LP disclosures.

Cox Enterprises (Private Family Ownershi.capitalNote: Family-owned conglomerate — acquisitions funded from the balance sheet; no external funds exist.

Mediacom (Founder-Owned / Private).capitalNote: Founder-owned — balance-sheet acquirer; no fundraising disclosures.
